body:
The brief was agreed before I started: one Reel and two Stories, with room to use my own voice. The team shared the key product points without scripting every line, so the content still felt natural for my audience.

The initial offer was ₹16,000. We agreed on ₹18,000 after confirming the deliverables in writing. There was one revision round, and the feedback stayed within the original brief.

Payment arrived 15 days after delivery without a follow-up. No additional ad usage was requested. For another creator considering this brand, I’d still recommend agreeing on the deliverables and payment date upfront — having that clarity made the whole collaboration easier.
reply: Thank you for the thoughtful feedback. We loved working with you!

body:
The brief was clear, but payment arrived 47 days after delivery. The campaign involved one Reel and two Stories, and there were three rounds of revisions. Some requests went beyond the original scope.

We agreed on ₹12,000 after an initial ₹10,000 offer. Usage rights were requested, but they were not paid separately. That is something I would negotiate more carefully next time.

The product was a good fit for my audience, but the extra edits and payment follow-ups made this more work than I expected. Put the revision limit, usage duration, and payment date in writing before you begin.

I delivered and posted the agreed Reel and two Stories. The team stopped responding after posting, and the agreed ₹24,000 payment never arrived.

There was no written agreement. I also saw the content being used in a paid ad without additional payment. I had not negotiated separate compensation for that use.

For a future collaboration, I would ask for a written scope, a payment milestone before posting, and clear terms for any advertising rights. I would not repeat this collaboration under the same terms.

I enjoyed creating the Reel and Stories for this campaign. The brief was clear, and the product suited my audience. We agreed on ₹10,000 plus product after an initial ₹8,000 cash offer.

The product had a claimed value of ₹3,000, though I would put its actual value closer to ₹2,000. There were two revision rounds.

Payment arrived after 45 days and a few follow-ups. I would ask for a written agreement and a firm payment date before taking on another project like this.
